description: Meshtastic client for the M5Stack CardputerZero

store.summary: Send and receive Meshtastic messages over LoRa on the CardputerZero.
store.description: A Meshtastic client for the M5Stack CardputerZero and Cap LoRa-1262. Public/private channel messaging, delivery results and retries, saved conversations/drafts, nodes and radar map, quick messages, location controls, traceroute, channel QR import/share, profiles and diagnostics. Optional phone messaging/viewing uses the official Meshtastic app over a separately installed, signed-in Tailscale connection; see the phone access guide. A native LVGL UI uses an unprivileged background radio supervisor. For the supported Debian 13 arm64 image. The package includes the qualified radio executable and hash-pinned Python runtime dependencies; standard system libraries are installed through Debian dependencies. See installation and dependency notices. Optional camera scanning also requires its documented camera/QR dependencies. Attach the antenna before enabling the radio. First setup is receive-only; transmitting and location sharing require explicit choices. Private channel keys and local history remain sensitive.
